settings.title: Settings & Shortcuts
settings.native_language_desc: Foreign text translated via Double-Ctrl or Manual mode translates into this language automatically.
settings.target_language_desc: Double-Alt in any input always converts toward this language. Modal/Manual also routes here if >= 70% of input is in your native language.
settings.preserve_markdown_desc: Detect H1–H3 headings, lists, and code blocks when copying from browsers and keep their visual layout.
settings.reset_modal_pos_desc: Clear saved drag coordinates so Quick Modal opens next to your cursor again.
settings.rerun_onboarding_desc: Open the interactive intro again to configure languages and review core shortcuts.
settings.auto_save_hint: All changes apply and save automatically.
settings.hotkey_syntax_hint: Syntax: Ctrl+Shift+X, Alt+Space, Ctrl+Alt+Left (Modifiers: Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Super)
settings.enable_double_alt: Double-Tap Alt: Translate & Replace in Input
settings.double_alt_desc: Press Alt twice rapidly to translate selected text in any input box and replace it immediately.
settings.auto_select_all_fallback: Auto-select (Ctrl+A) if nothing is selected during Double-Tap Alt
settings.auto_select_all_desc: Useful when typing directly in a message/search field without highlighting text first.
settings.enable_double_ctrl: Double-Tap Ctrl: Open Floating Translation Modal
settings.double_ctrl_desc: Press Ctrl twice rapidly to translate selected text in a floating modal with vocabulary highlights.
settings.restore_clipboard: Restore previous clipboard contents after capture/replace
settings.show_hud: Show floating HUD pill when switching prompts or replacing text
settings.platform_notes_desc: Windows runs natively. On macOS grant Accessibility & Screen Recording permissions; on Linux X11 works natively while Wayland requires compositor support.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Langhian
onboarding.subtitle: Ultra-lightweight pure-Rust desktop translator. Set up your languages in 20 seconds.
onboarding.cap_alt_desc: Type in any chat, search bar, or editor, tap Alt twice, and your text turns into natural target-language prose right in place.
onboarding.cap_ctrl_desc: Select any sentence in browsers, PDFs, or apps and tap Ctrl twice to inspect it in a sleek popup and star words to Vocabulary.
onboarding.cap_snip_desc: Translate text inside images with Vision AI models, and keep webpage headings and lists formatted cleanly.
onboarding.native_explain: The language you understand best. Double-Ctrl and Manual translations output into your Native Language (unless >= 70% of your input is already native).
onboarding.target_explain: The language you write or learn. Double-Alt in input boxes ALWAYS converts toward your Target Language so messages are never flipped backwards.
onboarding.step3_desc: Free Google Translate works immediately with no API key. You can also connect OpenRouter, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or Ollama anytime in Models.
